To help people transition through the game here is my suggested upgrade order. We just don't have almost any % increased damage options on trickster side of the tree, so your first t14-16s are going to feel lacking on single target this is remedied a ton once you get clusters in, even 2 modders: Upgrade Order I would recommend listed in order of power:price ratio would be: +1 or dot multi amulet -> corruption annoint -> Clusters ( 2 mods if you cant afford the bases to craft them ) -> 3 mod rare jewels -> a 2 mod cane with chaos dot multi + spell/chaos damage ( + socketed is good but then you'd need to 6 link a non-perfect cane wouldn't recommend ) -> Awakened void manipulation 5 -> Other awakened gems -> Empower 4 -> 3 mod cane ( if they are insane price unveil yourself you can make money going for phys ones for shockwavers or fire / phys / cold dot multi versions -> Light of meaning chaos damage -> replica dragonfang ( IF WILDLY EXPENSIVE like around 10div or something, if more around <=4/5 then move this up).
Make sure you are flame dashing / contagioning around every 6 seconds if you are on the arcane surge setup to maintain arcane surge buff ( also make sure your arcane surge is level 1 in the flamedash / contagion )
